implementation.name: Jolie 1.12 interpreter and console service
implementation.version_scope: Example follows the official v1.12.x service syntax.

fit.text: Service orchestration through input/output operations and explicit interfaces.

prerequisites.text: Learn services, embedded components and message request/response semantics.

execution.text: The interpreter runs a .ol service using the Jolie runtime.

behavior.text: Solicit-response operations wait for a reply; notifications use one-way operations.

tooling.text: The standard console and file services expose reusable operations.

example.run_instructions: With the matching Jolie 1.12 distribution installed, run jolie hello.ol.
example.expected_result: The embedded Console service prints PLLDN.

implementation.name: KCL configuration compiler
implementation.version_scope: Documentation as checked on 2026-10-13; no latest-version claim.

fit.text: Configuration validation and infrastructure models using schemas and constraints.

prerequisites.text: Learn schema attributes, types and declarative constraints; Python-like syntax is only an entry point.

execution.text: The KCL tool evaluates configuration source and generates configuration data.

behavior.text: Schemas separate configuration definitions from values, with type and range validation.

tooling.text: Format, lint, test, vet and documentation tools are provided.

maintenance.text: Version configuration models together with consumers such as Kubernetes or Terraform integrations.

costs.text: The Apache-licensed compiler is separate from infrastructure services configured by its output.

example.code:
schema Service:
    name: str
    port: int

service = Service {
    name = "PLLDN"
    port = 8080
}
example.run_instructions: With the documented KCL CLI installed, evaluate service.k using the kcl command.
example.expected_result: Generates configuration with a service name and integer port.

implementation.name: Kotlin/JVM command-line compiler
implementation.version_scope: This example targets the JVM; Native and JavaScript toolchains are separate targets.

fit.text: Typed JVM applications; other Kotlin targets use their respective compilers.

prerequisites.text: Install the Kotlin compiler and a Java runtime; learn functions and static types.

execution.text: kotlinc produces JVM class files or a JAR executed by Java.

behavior.text: A JAR can include the Kotlin runtime but still runs on the JVM.

tooling.text: Command-line compiler options support applications and libraries.

maintenance.text: Libraries compiled without the runtime need that dependency on the consuming classpath.

costs.text: The compiler's Apache license does not determine the chosen Java distribution's terms.

example.run_instructions: Run kotlinc hello.kt -include-runtime -d hello.jar, then java -jar hello.jar.
